raw:
You set your own glass and cutlery beside the plates on the kitchen counter. No argument rises from the office—only Nell’s low, practical voice and Owen answering too quietly to make out.

Jo stacks the serving dishes by the sink. “That’s plenty, Rowan. You’ve done your bit.”

The office door opens a moment later. Owen comes out first, expression unreadable, while Nell makes a brief note on her clipboard before putting it away.

From the auditorium, Rosa’s camera shutter clicks again. Martin’s voice carries faintly through the doors: “No, that bit was added later.”
